event_name: Learning logical Pauli noise in quantum error correction

sources.title: Learning Logical Pauli Noise in Quantum Error Correction
evidence_supported: For arbitrary stabilizer codes, subsystem codes, and data-syndrome codes, the paper proves conditions under which the logical error channel induced by Pauli noise can be estimated from syndrome data.
The stated condition is that the code can correct the noise.
The work is a characterization and inference method for quantum error correction rather than an external application discovery.
Received, accepted, published, and issue dates are publication-process dates and do not by themselves establish internal method-generation or theorem-verification dates.
